description: PF3 with CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM naming COUSR00C - the ELSE arm of the two-way test at app/cbl/COUSR03C.cbl:112, which at :114-117 carries the predecessor into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM instead of falling back to the hard-coded 'COADM01C' at :113. This is case16's twin, and its only intended differences from it are the one input item under test, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, and the transfer target that item produces; every other declared value is held identical on purpose, because a pair that changed two things at once would pin neither. EIBCALEN is 194 so :94 copies the area in, CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is 1 so :95 sends the flow down the re-entry branch, :107 performs RECEIVE-USRDEL-SCREEN, and the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at :108-130 matches its SECOND arm - DFHENTER, then DFHPF3, then DFHPF4, DFHPF5, DFHPF12 and WHEN OTHER last, first match winning. :112 tests CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM against SPACES OR LOW-VALUES and is FALSE because the item holds 'COUSR00C', so :115-116 moves it into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM and :118 performs RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN. THE ORDERING SUBTLETY THIS CASE EXISTS TO PIN: one field is READ at :112 and OVERWRITTEN at :203, so CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM arrives as 'COUSR00C' and leaves as 'COUSR03C' - its input and output values genuinely differ, and a translation that stamped WS-PGMNAME before evaluating the branch would take this ELSE arm carrying 'COUSR03C' and transfer the screen to itself, which is an infinite navigation loop. RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN at :197-208 then runs in source order: the :199-201 guard is FALSE because :115-116 has already set CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, so the 'COSGN00C' default is BYPASSED and nextProgram is 'COUSR00C' - neither the 'COADM01C' fallback case16 pins nor the 'COSGN00C' default case01 pins; :202 writes CDEMO-FROM-TRANID from WS-TRANID as 'CU03'; :203 writes CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM from WS-PGMNAME as 'COUSR03C'; :204 writes CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT from MOVE ZEROS as 0, which hands the next program a fresh ENTER context; and :205-208 XCTLs. 'COUSR00C' is a real predecessor rather than an arbitrary literal: app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl:202-207 moves 'COUSR03C' into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM and then WS-TRANID and WS-PGMNAME - 'CU00' and 'COUSR00C' at :35-36 - into CDEMO-FROM-TRANID and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM before XCTLing here, which is the navigation an operator performs by selecting D against a row of the user list. Two declared input items are left exactly as case16 declares them, deliberately, because COUSR03C cannot observe either on this path and holding them constant is what isolates the one item :112 tests: CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, which this program never READS and only WRITES at :202, so its output is 'CU03' whatever arrives; and CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, which :115-116 overwrites before :199 tests it. The XCTL is projected as a nextProgram response field, statelessly - no server-side forward, no redirect chain, no session affinity, the client issues the follow-up call - and every other commarea item travels through untouched, which is why all 22 are pinned item by item rather than left implicit. SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN is never performed, so sends is empty and no map is painted; the EXEC CICS RETURN at :134 is never reached because the XCTL transfers control. No error arises, so no message text and no DFHRED-plus-'*' highlight: COUSR03C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY and moves exactly one attribute item, ERRMSGC, at :285 and :317, neither of which is on this path; the AID mnemonic is taken from common.CicsAid because DFHAID is IBM-supplied and absent from this repository, which is risk R-D. The two blank lines in expectedMessages are neither an omission nor an invention: :87-88 move SPACES to WS-MESSAGE and to ERRMSGO OF COUSR3AO UNCONDITIONALLY and BEFORE the :90 test, so an 80-character and a 78-character blank line are genuinely observable on this path and are pinned on their own channels at their own declared widths, exactly as case01 and case16 pin them. What this case asserts is therefore zero message TEXT, not zero channels. USRSEC is seeded although this path never touches it, so that 'nothing was written' is a POSITIVE assertion rather than an absence of interest: expectedWrites is empty and all ten rows are pinned UNCHANGED at zero-based indices 0-9, each as its six CSUSR01Y fields and as its full 80-byte image, which is what proves a navigation path performs no I/O. No repository interaction is declared and none happens, so no FILE STATUS or RESP outcome is fabricated for a call site that does not exist on this path: the EXEC CICS READ ... UPDATE at :269-278 and the keyless EXEC CICS DELETE at :307-311 are both unreached, and gate G47 therefore has no call site here. The RECEIVE at :232-238 does capture RESP and RESP2 into WS-RESP-CD and WS-REAS-CD, and the program never evaluates them - that is preserved as written, and no receive-failure branch is invented. The payload contract is the eleven xxxI items of app/cpy-bms/COUSR03.CPY and nothing else - TRNNAMEI X(4), TITLE01I X(40), CURDATEI X(8), PGMNAMEI X(8), TITLE02I X(40), CURTIMEI X(8), USRIDINI X(8), FNAMEI X(20), LNAMEI X(20), USRTYPEI X(1), ERRMSGI X(78) - eleven exactly, with NO password item anywhere in the mapset, and with the xxxL, xxxF and xxxA items remaining length, flag and attribute METADATA rather than payload members. The one map field declared here is USRIDINI, spelt USRIDIN and not USERID, carrying what the operator had typed before pressing the back key; the clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:35 as case01 pins it, so nothing non-deterministic enters the fixture and the header renders as 07/19/22 and 23:12:35. Gates G32, G35, G39 and G43 do not apply here: there is no backward GO TO to restructure, COUSR03C contains no CALL 'CEE3ABD' and an online transaction sets no RETURN-CODE, this screen paginates nothing, and the 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC concurrency check belongs to COACTUPC and COCRDUPC rather than to this program. PROVENANCE: every value here is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of the sources below and is NOT captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL - running it is empirically impossible in this environment (no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler's indexed-file handler is disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository), which is the documented eight-blocker deviation escalated as risk R-A; it changes the provenance of the expected values and nothing else. Derived from app/cbl/COUSR03C.cbl:111-118 - the ELSE at :114-117 specifically, complementing the fallback arm case16 drives - and :197-208, with :36-37 for WS-PGMNAME and WS-TRANID, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:19-44 (160 bytes) plus app/cbl/COUSR03C.cbl:50-58 (the 34-byte CDEMO-CU03-INFO extension, 160 + 34 = 194 = EIBCALEN, carried in the DTO rather than folded into the shared 160-byte NavigationContext), app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:17-23 (8+20+20+8+1 = 57, plus SEC-USR-FILLER's 23 = 80), app/cpy-bms/COUSR03.CPY, app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:479-480 for TRANSACTION(CU03) PROGRAM(COUSR03C), app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl:35-36 and :202-207 for the predecessor this case names, and the ten in-stream rows of app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44, whose 57-character width against the LRECL=80 RECFM=FB of :48 and the RECORDSIZE(80,80) KEYS(8,0) of :65-66 is exactly what the declared normalisation supplies. The literal PASSWORD in SEC-USR-PWD is legacy sample data carried byte for byte because the copybook places it inside the eighty bytes; plaintext credentials are an inherited property of the legacy design rather than a choice made here, this screen has no password field and never reads or paints the span, and no hashing, encoding or token is introduced. The dataset is addressed only by its USRSEC binding key, never by a literal dataset name.
